다음 분은 복용하지 마세요. 이 약에 과민증 환자, 만 3개월 미만의 영아는 이 약을 복용하지 마세요.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 고옥살산뇨증(뇨중에 과량의 수산염이 배설되는 상태), 임부 및 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성, 수유부, 미숙아, 유아, 통풍 또는 신장결석, 황색5호에 과민증 환자 또는 경험자, 폴산이 부족한 환자는 약사와 상의하세요.

정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키세요.

각종 요검사 시에 혈당의 검출을 방해할 수 있으며, 요를 황색으로 변하게 하여 임상검사치에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

1개월 정도 복용하여도 증상의 개선이 없을 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

레보도파, 에스트로겐을 포함한 경구용 피임제와 함께 복용하지 마세요.

en.title: Bioramin Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, and in old age, and to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (such as lower back pain and shoulder stiffness), beriberi, and eye fatigue.
en.usage:
Adults take 1 tablet at a time, 2 times a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, or infants under 3 months of age.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have hyperoxaluria (a condition in which excessive oxalate is excreted in the urine), are pregnant or possibly pregnant, are breastfeeding, or in the case of premature or young infants, or if you have gout or kidney stones, are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5 or have experienced such a reaction, or are deficient in folic acid.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of blood sugar in various urine tests and may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Do not take together with levodopa or oral contraceptives containing estrogen.

If you experience upper abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, constipation, rash, redness (flushing), nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomatitis (sores in the mouth), loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, or if menstruation starts earlier than expected, becomes gradually heavier, or bleeding lasts longer, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Porigron Soft Capsule · Ipharm Gold Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to relieve dry-eye sensation, for poor development of teeth and bones, night blindness, prevention of rickets, and to supply vitamins A and D during pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, growth periods, and in old age.
en.usage:
Adults and those aged 15 and over take 2 capsules once a day; children aged 7 to under 15 take 1 capsule once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Warning: Taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A per day may cause congenital malformations. Do not take this medicine if you are within the first 3 months of pregnancy or possibly pregnant.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: those hypersensitive or allergic to soybean oil, soybeans, or peanuts. If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are within the first 3 months of pregnancy or planning pregnancy, have a lipid metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, require careful administration of lipid emulsions, or are at particular risk from fat overload.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

When giving to children, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Consult a pharmacist when using together with intravenous lipid preparations or lipid emulsions.

If you experience itching, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Bicaperol Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamin D during pregnancy and breastfeeding, growth periods, and in old age, and to prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets.
en.usage:
Adults and those aged 8 and over take 1 tablet once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, infants under 12 months of age, or patients with hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, kidney stones, severe renal failure, or hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist in the case of infants under 1 year of age or children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet, if you are pregnant or possibly pregnant or breastfeeding, in the case of premature or young infants, or if you have cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, kidney impairment, or hypoproteinemia, are taking cardiac glycosides, or have or have had kidney stones.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

When giving to children, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist when taking together with cardiac glycosides, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and around the time of taking it.

If you experience nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Feripol Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for the prevention and treatment of iron-deficiency anemia.
en.usage:
Adults take 1 capsule once a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, infants under 12 months of age, or patients with hemochromatosis (a disease in which iron deposits in the liver and pancreas due to abnormal iron metabolism), hemosiderosis, non-iron-deficiency anemia, or hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you have a gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional colitis, cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, kidney impairment, or hypoproteinemia, are deficient in folic acid, or are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

While taking this medicine, do not take together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. content_json.efficacy: 만성 간염, 독성 간질환의 보조 치료에 사용하는 일반의약품입니다.
content_json.caution:
다음 분은 복용하지 마세요. 이 약에 과민증 환자, 갈락토오스 불내성, Lapp 유당분해효소 결핍증 또는 포도당-갈락토오스 흡수장애 등의 유전적인 문제가 있는 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마세요.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 폴산이 부족한 환자는 약사와 상의하세요.

정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키세요.

요를 황색으로 변하게 하여 임상검사치에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

1개월 정도 복용하여도 증상의 개선이 없을 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

레바도파와 함께 복용하지 마세요.

가려움, 피부발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 변비, 메스꺼움, 상복부 불쾌감 등이 나타나는 경우에는 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.
content_json.ingredientSelection:
제품에 따라 성분 구성과 함량이 다를 수 있으니, 지병이나 복용 중인 약이 있으면 매장의 약사에게 확인하세요.
증상이 지속되거나 궁금한 점이 있으면 매장 내 약사 등 전문가와 상담하세요.

en.title: Hanseo Hepadif 300 Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as adjunctive treatment for chronic hepatitis and toxic liver disease.
en.usage:
Adults take 1 capsule at a time, 2 to 3 times a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, or patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist if you are deficient in folic acid.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

This medicine may turn the urine yellow, affecting clinical test values.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Do not take together with levodopa.

If you experience itching, skin rash, redness (flushing), constipation, nausea, or upper abdominal discomfort, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

en.title: Admin Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins D and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, lowered physical strength during or after illness, growth periods, and in old age, and to prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets.
en.usage:
Children aged 8 and over and adults take 1 tablet at a time, 2 times a day.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
en.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients hypersensitive to this medicine, infants under 3 months of age, or patients with hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, kidney stones, or hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking. Before taking this medicine, consult a pharmacist in the case of infants under 1 year of age or children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet, if you are pregnant or possibly pregnant or breastfeeding, in the case of premature or young infants, or if you have hyperoxaluria (a condition in which excessive oxalate is excreted in the urine), or have or have had gout or kidney stones.

Keep strictly to the stated dosage and directions.

When giving to children, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of blood sugar in various urine tests.

If symptoms do not improve after about 1 month of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.

If you experience nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea, stop taking it immediately and consult a pharmacist.
